coder_notes: DB107-RRV (Toca 511) is a gene therapy vector, listed as excluded_intervention_type. DB107-FC (extended-release flucytosine) is the only pharmacological agent; coded experimental_monotherapy by analogy with 'checkpoint inhibitor + vaccine', but it acts only as a prodrug converted by the vector, so flagged for adjudication. MGMT status assigns the arm (TMZ vs no TMZ); linked to the TMZ backbone, so not candidate-matched. Both IDH-mutant astrocytoma and IDH-wildtype glioblastoma are eligible, so IDH is not an entry requirement; it is tested centrally and PFS is analysed by genomic subsets. DGM7 (Denovo Genomic Marker 7) is measured from a blood sample (germline predictive marker) and not recorded as a tumour biomarker; primary PFS analysis is 'informed by biomarker status, DGM7'.
